models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.description: Default portable local LLM for Docker Model Runner llama.cpp.
hardware_notes: Apple Silicon requires at least 16GB unified memory.
NVIDIA CUDA requires at least 8GB VRAM.
CPU-only use is force-only because it is slow for the default model.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Latest
models.description: Large Docker Model Runner LLM for 48GB-or-above GPU or integrated-GPU nodes.
hardware_notes: Requires a 48GB-or-above GPU or integrated GPU memory pool.
DGX Spark / GB10 and Apple Silicon shared CPU-GPU memory are reported by MirrorNeuron as model-placement memory.

models.name: OtterDesk Video Watch VLM
models.description: Default NVIDIA-accelerated multimodal model for the video watch assistant.
hardware_notes: Requires a high-end NVIDIA CUDA node advertised as DGX Spark, GH200, H100, H200, B200, GB10, or GB200 class.
Docker Model Runner should be configured for NVIDIA acceleration before live video runs.

models.name: OtterDesk Customer Service Voice LLM
models.description: Default NVIDIA-accelerated LLM for the customer-service voice coworker.
hardware_notes: Requires a high-end NVIDIA CUDA node advertised as DGX Spark, GH200, H100, H200, B200, GB10, or GB200 class.
ASR and TTS are tracked as NVIDIA service model dependencies until Docker Model Runner exposes audio endpoints.

models.name: OtterDesk Customer Service ASR
models.description: Required NVIDIA speech-to-text service for the customer-service voice coworker.

models.name: OtterDesk Customer Service TTS
models.description: Required NVIDIA text-to-speech service for the customer-service voice coworker.

models.name: Nemotron 3 33B
models.description: Large local Ollama-compatible LLM used by simulation and research blueprints.
hardware_notes: Should run on a high-end NVIDIA CUDA node with the Ollama model service already advertised.
